content: 1. Mifepristone increases the levels or effects of erythromycin ethylsuccinate by inhibiting the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. It is recommended to avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is necessary, monitor the patient closely. 2. Erythromycin lactobionate increases the levels or effects of mifepristone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination may also prolong the QTc interval. Therapy modification or close monitoring is advised. Avoid or use an alternative drug if possible. 3.
